title: Update an existing join
summary: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements.
introduction: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements. Your task: Call draw with four values.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for update an existing join

blocks.text: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements. Extra old elements are removed by the join.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Update an existing join

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `join` creates, updates and removes selected elements to match the bound data.

blocks.text: The final chart has two circles with radii 15 and 25. The third old circle is removed.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: For objects that can reorder, supply a stable key to data. Index matching alone can follow the wrong item.
